# Read-only review task

Read `statistics_helper.py` in the directory you were given. Do not modify any file, and do
not read anything outside that directory.

Exactly one function in that file has a defect that makes it raise an exception on an input
the other function handles correctly. Identify it.

Answer as JSON matching the schema you were given. Report the defect as a single finding.
Name the file and the function, state the input that triggers the failure, and state which
exception is raised. Do not report style preferences, missing type hints, or missing tests
as findings.
